shortDescription: Perform an SNMP get against a remote device for one or more OIDs

options.name: best_guess
options.description: This setting controls how return value oids are parsed. Setting to 0 causes a regular lookup. Setting to 1 causes a regular expression match (defined as -Ib in snmpcmd). Setting to 2 causes a random access lookup (defined as -IR in snmpcmd).

options.name: enums
options.description: Set to `True` to have integer return values converted to enumeration identifiers if possible.

options.name: long_names
options.description: Set to `True` to have OIDS generated preferring longer Mib name convention.

options.name: numeric
options.description: Set to `True to have `oids` returned untranslated (i.e. dotted-decimal).

options.name: oids
options.description: A dictionary of entries to get from the remote device

options.name: sprint_value
options.description: Set to `True` to have return values formatted with netsnmp's sprint_value function. This will result in certain data types being returned in non-canonical format. Values returned with this option set may not be appropriate for 'set' operations
